items.titleOriginal: Judge denies xAI’s request to block Minnesota ban on ‘nudify’ apps
items.summaryOriginal: Despite a lawsuit from xAI, a Minnesota ban on apps that allow users to “nudify” images can move forward.
items.author: Anthony Ha
items.importanceReasonZh: 该事件涉及AI公司法律纠纷与州级监管，对AI应用合规有影响，但非重大技术突破或政策变革。
items.importanceReasonEn: The event involves legal disputes and state-level regulation for AI companies, impacting AI app compliance, but is not a major tech breakthrough or policy shift.
items.titleZh: 法官驳回xAI关于阻止明尼苏达州禁止“脱衣”应用的请求
items.titleEn: Judge denies xAI's request to block Minnesota ban on 'nudify' apps
items.summaryZh: 尽管xAI提起诉讼，明尼苏达州禁止用户“脱衣”图像的应用的禁令仍可继续推进。
items.summaryEn: Despite a lawsuit from xAI, a Minnesota ban on apps that allow users to 'nudify' images can move forward.

items.titleOriginal: YouTuber Hank Green says his AI usage is ‘not healthy’
items.summaryOriginal: Green offered a remarkable apology, saying that "the level of dopamine that I've been getting from interacting with LLMs ... is not healthy for me or good for the world."
items.author: Anthony Ha
items.importanceReasonZh: 该事件涉及知名人士对 AI 使用的反思，可能引发公众对 AI 成瘾性的讨论，具有一定社会影响力。
items.importanceReasonEn: The event involves a well-known figure's reflection on AI usage, potentially sparking public discussion on AI addiction, with moderate social impact.
items.titleZh: YouTuber Hank Green 表示其 AI 使用“不健康”
items.titleEn: YouTuber Hank Green says his AI usage is 'not healthy'
items.summaryZh: Hank Green 发表了一番引人注目的道歉，称“我从与 LLM 互动中获得的 dopamine 水平……对我个人不健康，对世界也无益。”
items.summaryEn: Green offered a remarkable apology, saying that "the level of dopamine that I've been getting from interacting with LLMs ... is not healthy for me or good for the world."

items.titleOriginal: This $9 key physically locks your most addictive apps

items.author: Lauren Forristal

items.importanceReasonEn: This product offers a low-cost innovative solution to digital addiction, with market appeal.
